name: draft
description: Writing to a length in one draft and cuts, not rewrites. When your prompt sets a word limit, it carries your setting to plan each part's share and land the length in one draft, or one more write; each write of a document then shows its words as wc -w counts them, and when it is well over, each section's target. Silent without a limit. Nothing leaves your machine.

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Turn this mod off or on; /mods does it for all of the pack.

order.title: Writing to a length
order.description: A prompt that sets a word limit carries your setting: plan each part's share of the words and aim under the limit; a draft well over it is written once more to section targets, not cut down in rounds.

gauge.title: Words after each write
gauge.description: Once a prompt has set a word limit, each Write or Edit of a Markdown or text file shows its words against the limit, and each section's target when it is well over.
